correctness.rationale: The complete root-polytope volume follows from the positive/negative coordinate-mass orthant decomposition and Vandermonde. An oriented deleted-root cap is a lattice-height-one pyramid over a crosspolytope of determinant 1/2, giving 2^(n-3); disjoint deleted-edge caps cannot overlap in positive-volume interiors, so losses add. An independent check of the previously published full h*-numerator at 1 recovers the same formula for 3<=n<=18, and the stronger exact published identity gives all n. No invalid extrapolation is used.
